exclusion_codes.RETIRED: Player is recorded as retired and remains only in the historical master.
exclusion_codes.WITHOUT_CLUB_TOO_LONG: Player has been without a club longer than the configured active-database limit.
exclusion_codes.DUPLICATE: Another master record uses the same Transfermarkt identity.
exclusion_codes.INVALID_TRANSFERMARKT_RECORD: Required identity, name or age data is invalid or missing.
exclusion_codes.UNDER_REVIEW: Player has been explicitly held for human review.
exclusion_codes.STAFF_NOT_PLAYER: Record appears to represent coaching, executive or other non-playing staff.

layers.transfermarkt_master: Historical source layer. Records are preserved even when retired or excluded.
layers.tbg_registry: Canonical identity layer annotated with publication eligibility and exclusion reasons.
layers.published_database: Active, valid and eligible players available to the live TBG world and Pink Final.
